A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same DuFal research work, with complete, readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendix A.1–A.4. Text comparison and page rendering support a reliable comparison throughout.

before.justification: v1 reports original DuFal reconstruction results on LUNA16 and ToothFairy, component ablations, downstream lung segmentation, and additional experiments in Appendix A.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including reconstruction evaluations in Tables 2–3, segmentation in Table 11, and appendix experiments in Tables 12–15.

M1.justification: The dual-encoder architecture, global and local HiLocFFNO branches, SCF factorization, CAFF fusion, training objective, and intensity-field decoding remain identical.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate LUNA16 chest CT and ToothFairy dental CBCT reconstruction with 6, 8, and 10 views, alongside the same downstream lung segmentation and supplementary scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments. Tables 2–3 retain FDK, SART, NAF, NeRP, FreeSeed, DIF-Net, and DIF-Gaussian; Table 7 retains FBPConvNet, and Appendix A.4 retains C2RV-Net.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 retains identical dataset splits, resampling, projection simulation, view counts, optimization settings, training budgets, and metrics. Appendix evaluation settings, including initialization comparisons, are also unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 6 retains the same component, fusion, factorization, integration, efficiency, ROI-weighted evaluation, and segmentation analyses. Appendix A.1–A.3 retains identical query/key/value, frequency-mode, and patch-size ablations.

E5.justification: The uncertainty entries in Tables 2–3 and Mean/Std summaries in Tables 13–14 are identical. No repeated-run, seed, uncertainty-estimation, or statistical-testing information changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results in Tables 2–15 and qualitative examples in Figures 4–8 are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains DuFal's 6-view LUNA16 PSNR of 28.20 ± 0.38 dB.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, training objective, and mathematical definitions and derivations in Sections 3–4, including Equations 1–12, are unchanged. No theoretical results or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain identical claims about frequency-aware reconstruction, modular integration, anatomical-detail preservation, and 82.2% parameter reduction.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged, including appendix explanations of attention configuration and sensitivity. Section 7 retains the same qualifications about modality generalization, interpretability, and untested motion-artifact handling.

D1.justification: Implementation, preprocessing, optimization, initialization, and resource-access disclosures are unchanged. The revised bibliography URL identifies prior research; it does not change access to DuFal code or data.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. The Kalimuthu et al. LOGLO-FNO entry is updated from an arXiv reference to publication metadata for the same work, without changing its discussion in Section 4.1.

P1.justification: Edits are limited to the arXiv version/date stamp and one bibliography entry: LOGLO-FNO capitalization, Holzmüller's diacritic, and added TMLR publication details, ISSN, OpenReview URL, and J2C Certification. Scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded LOGLO-FNO reference causes localized line wrapping and spacing changes on page 19, and the first-page arXiv stamp changes. All figures, tables, and remaining pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 updates one reference's publication metadata and the arXiv stamp. These limited bibliographic and layout edits leave the scientific explanation, evidence, reproducibility information, limitations, and appendices unchanged, producing no meaningful overall quality difference.
